raw_text: Violent protests against the Agnipath military recruitment scheme erupted across Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Haryana on Saturday with railway stations and trains set ablaze at multiple locations. The protests, coordinated through Telegram groups and X accounts, saw arson at Patna Junction, Danapur, and several stations along the Patna-Gaya route. India Today has confirmed that social media coordination preceded mainstream coverage by approximately six hours.
clean_text: Violent anti-Agnipath protests across Bihar, UP, and Haryana with railway stations and trains set ablaze. Social media coordination on Telegram and X preceded mainstream coverage by six hours.
